items.note: Five main-entry files took `isDev` from `@weasel-js/react`, whose barrel imports `react`. They now take it from `@weasel-js/registry`, and so does `useContributions.ts`. A test now imports `./index` with `react` mocked to throw.

items.claim: `siblingsOf` splits a map key at an escaped dot
items.note: The path helpers moved to `menus/paths.ts`, and a new `parentPath` there honors the escape.

items.claim: Held modifier trigger in another case gets no loosening
items.note: `offhandKeyFor`, `heldModifierOf` and `heldKeySpec`'s modifier test now ignore case.

items.claim: dlog: `*` inside a namespace list doesn't enable everything
An unmounting publisher clears a selection another live publisher still holds
items.note: The check now covers both orders, the later or the earlier of two publishers going away.

items.claim: Route-conflict check skips late-registered actions and bindings changed under the same id
items.note: The signature now covers each entry's eligibility and bindings, the registered actions, and the overrides. It is computed inside the dev-only effect, so production builds don't pay for it.
